We're thrilled to share that Corvid Labs has been awarded a £120,000 contract with the Yorkshire Ambulance Service. 🚑

We're a 9-person design studio in Leeds, and this is one of the most meaningful projects we've taken on. The work of Yorkshire Ambulance Service touches people on some of the hardest days of their lives, and we don't take the responsibility lightly.

Good design matters most when the stakes are high. Clear, considered, human-centred work can make life easier for the people delivering care and for the communities who depend on them. That's what we'll bring to this partnership.

Winning this contract, confirmed on 12 June 2026, is a proud moment for our whole team. Every person in our studio has helped build the reputation that got us here, and we're excited to put that effort to work for our home region.

Thank you to the Yorkshire Ambulance Service team for their trust. We can't wait to get started.

Big things can come from small teams. 💪
